scope: Evidence review before Home Village Super Hog Rider Divide and Conquer is enabled.

sources.title: New Super Troop
sources.finding: On destruction Hog and Rider split into independent units; Hog jumps Walls and targets Defenses, Rider targets nearest Building. The launch table publishes both child stats only at Super Hog Rider levels 10–12, including Rider 2× Wall damage.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.finding: TH18 adds Hog Rider and Super Hog Rider level 15, but publishes no Super Hog or Super Rider level-15 values or spawn timing.

sources.title: Pinned normalized Hog Rider superTroop payload
sources.finding: Pinned payload supplies parent L10–15 data but no materializable Super Hog or Super Rider child records.

established: The destruction split and both child target priorities are primary-confirmed.
The L10–12 child HP/DPS/speeds and Rider 2× Wall damage are primary-confirmed.
unresolved: No public source supplies L13–15 child stats, despite L15 being an applicable TH18 parent level.
No source specifies spawn delay, spawn positions/collision, command/target inheritance, death-tick ordering, child attack cadence/range, or whether any parent effects carry over.
No source verifies child sprites, footprints, mouse selection or overlays.
decision: Do not enable super_hog_rider in Core, GUI or RL until child records cover all applicable TH18 levels and a spawn lifecycle is source-identified. Scaling the launch children from parent values would be invented data.
